subject: Tenant-specific retention variance request — Clarion Health
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@clarionhealth.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@clarionhealth.com
Date: Thu, 14 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Tenant retention variance request — Clarion Health

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — Clarion is excited about Redwood's latency profile. We've been working with our internal auditors and they require a tenant-specific retention variance for production access logs: a 24-month retention window for raw request logs (including timestamp, model-id, request-id, and request/response hashes) to satisfy a pending regulatory audit.

Can Redwood support a customer-specific exception to retain those logs for 24 months rather than the default 90 days? If so, we need:
- A written variance proposal with controls and retention hang/review dates
- Evidence that logs are encrypted and access-controlled (SOC 2 / audit sample)
- A proposed timeline and any impact to pricing or SLAs

I've attached our internal compliance note for context.

Thanks,
Elena
Security & Privacy | Clarion Health
[Attachment: clarion-audit-note.pdf (pdf, 85 KB)]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@clarionhealth.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 14 May 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Tenant retention variance request — Clarion Health

Elena,

Appreciate the clear ask and the note — this is absolutely something we can discuss. Quick responses to your bullets:

- We'll draft a tenant-specific variance that documents retention windows, retention triggers, and review cadence.
- We can provide SOC 2 evidence for encryption and role-based access controls; I'll include an audit sample and a redacted log extract.
- Need to confirm impacts to storage/pricing with the product ops team — copying Priyom for commercial.

Marcus and Laura — could you weigh in on feasibility and required contractual language? Key considerations from our side: encryption at rest, limited-privileged access, immutable archival where needed, and a documented retention deletion workflow. Also: are there minimum SLAs or additional indemnities we need to flag?

Elena — we'll aim to get a proposal and supporting evidence back to you by EOD Monday (May 18). If that timeline doesn't work, tell me your hard deadline.

Best,
Rishi
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 15 May 2026 13:20:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Tenant retention variance request — Clarion Health

Team,

Reviewed Clarion's ask. Technical notes / constraints:

1) Current default: raw request logs retained 90 days in hot storage; 12 months in cold archival (hashed payloads, limited metadata).
2) We can offer tenant-scoped extended retention (24 months) under a scoped exception, provided the following are implemented:
   - Logs encrypted with customer-agnostic KMS keys (we can support customer-managed keys as part of Private deployments; hosted customers use Redwood-managed KMS)
   - Role-based access with two-person review for any access to raw request content
   - Audit trail for every access (who/when/why) retained for same 24-month window
   - Immutable WORM-like archival for any retention beyond 12 months to prevent accidental deletion
3) Operational impact: additional storage and archived retrieval costs; potential SLA adjustments for retrieval time from long-term archive.

Open questions for legal/commercial:
- Do we require a formal Data Processing Addendum (DPA) amendment or a standalone retention variance agreement?
- Will Clarion require KMS/HSM integration (which pushes toward Dedicated/Private)?

I'll prepare a short technical appendix for the variance that outlines controls and who to notify for access requests.

— Marcus
Lead Security Engineer
[Attachment: proposed-retention-appendix.md (md, 6 KB)]

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 16 May 2026 09:41:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Tenant retention variance request — Clarion Health

Rishi / team,

Legal guidance and recommended contractual language: we can accommodate a tenant-specific retention variance via a short amendment to the DPA that includes:

- Scope: list of log types (request metadata, request/response hashes, model-id) to be retained 24 months.
- Controls: encryption at rest, RBAC, access justification, audit trail retention.
- Access: Clarion may request redacted samples for audit; any full-log access must be via a documented, approved process with two-person authorization and eDiscovery/attestation logged.
- Deletion: upon expiry we will purge raw content; hashed indexes may persist for fraud-detection purposes for up to an additional 60 days unless Clarion specifies otherwise.
- Pricing/Fees: recommend an incremental monthly storage surcharge (TBD by Priyom) or one-time archiving setup fee.
- Liability: carve-outs for customer-supplied data; no change to indemnity but include cooperative audit language.

Marcus — please include the exact access-control steps and verification points we should require. Rishi / Priyom — once we have pricing I'll draft the amendment and a one-page summary for the customer.

Laura
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@clarionhealth.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 17:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Tenant retention variance request — Clarion Health

Elena — thanks for your patience. Attached is a draft tenant-retention variance (PDF) and a short technical appendix showing controls and a redacted log sample. Highlights:

- Proposed retention: 24 months for named log types (request metadata, model-id, request/response hashes).
- Controls: AES-256 encryption at rest, role-based access with two-person approval for raw content access, immutability for archived logs, and parity in access audit retention (24 months).
- Deletion process: automated purge upon expiry with a 72-hour documented hold window if Clarion submits a legal hold.
- Commercial: Priyom will follow up separately with a storage surcharge estimate; expect ~9–12% uplift on monthly bill for the extended storage profile (rough estimate pending final usage numbers).

Next steps (Mutual Action Plan):
1) Clarion review and confirm scope by May 21
2) Redwood to finalize pricing and DPA amendment by May 25
3) Sign amendment (DocuSign) and enable tenant retention policy by June 4

Links: Draft variance & appendix attached and DocuSign preview here: https://app.docusign.com/embeddedSigning/12345-clarion-retention

Please see attachments: data-retention-proposal_v2.pdf, audit_log_sample.csv, clarion-soc2-questionnaire_filled.xlsx

If that timeline works, I'll queue the DocuSign and loop in our implementation lead to schedule the archival configuration.

Best,
Rishi
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
